statement: A durable cluster identity is minted at first seed bootstrap, persisted in the rejoin hints, an authoritative cluster row, and the raft snapshot-checkpoint seam (replacing the config-pinned 'lagrange-default-cluster' default), and the bootstrap request carries expectedClusterId with seed-side rejection on mismatch, so a node can never join or seed over state belonging to a different cluster. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/durable-cluster-identity-v2.receipt.json (written by a deterministic evidence harness over real focused test runs) with outstanding 0 — every mint/persist, join-gate, and seam-wiring receipt passing.
